summary: Iteration 13 Testing: Verified new 'Interesados' feature that separates WhatsApp-originated clients from manual clients. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests confirmed: Interesados page loads with WhatsApp client cards, promote buttons work, detail modal has 'Promover a Cliente' button, and Clientes page only shows manual clients.

source_filter_api: ✓ GET /api/clients/?source=manual&trash=false returns only manual clients (9 found)
✓ GET /api/clients/?source=whatsapp&trash=false returns only WhatsApp clients (1 remaining)
✓ All clients have valid source field (manual or whatsapp)
promote_endpoint: ✓ POST /api/clients/{id}/promote changes source from whatsapp to manual
✓ POST /api/clients/{id}/promote returns 400 if already manual ('Este registro ya es un cliente')
✓ Promoted client moves from Interesados to Clientes section
interesados_frontend: ✓ Interesados page loads at /interesados with data-testid='interesados-page'
✓ Page shows WhatsApp icon (MessageCircle) in header and on cards
✓ Interesado cards have promote button (ArrowRightCircle icon)
✓ Detail modal has 'Promover a Cliente' button
clientes_frontend: ✓ Clientes page at /clients loads with data-testid='clients-page'
✓ Clientes page shows 9 clients (including promoted 'Cliente WhatsApp ST01')
✓ No WhatsApp-only clients visible on Clientes page

critical_code_review_comments: Interesados feature properly separates WhatsApp clients from manual clients
Promote endpoint correctly updates source field and logs activity
Frontend correctly filters clients by source parameter
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing
WhatsApp icon (MessageCircle) visible on cards and modal headers
seed_data_creation: Used existing WhatsApp clients (source=whatsapp). Promoted 'Cliente WhatsApp ST01' to manual during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 verified the 'Interesados' feature: (1) GET /api/clients/?source=whatsapp returns WhatsApp-originated clients, (2) GET /api/clients/?source=manual returns manual clients, (3) POST /api/clients/{id}/promote changes source from 'whatsapp' to 'manual', (4) Frontend Interesados page at /interesados shows WhatsApp clients with promote buttons, (5) Frontend Clientes page at /clients only shows manual clients. Note: One WhatsApp client was promoted during testing, leaving 1 WhatsApp client remaining.
